$about: Water ripple VFX. Data only — no functions, no asset paths. Unknown keys are ignored; invalid values fall back to the defaults in config.ts and are reported in the console.

quality.$about: Multipliers applied on top of the pools and the per-event ring count. Switch presets at runtime; no buffers are reallocated.

ripples.$about: The expanding rings. maxRipples counts RINGS, not events: a 3-ring impact occupies three slots. surfaceOffset lifts the rings off the water plane so they do not z-fight with it.

defaults.$about: Fallbacks for every preset and every emit() option. A preset only lists what it changes.

spray.$about: Droplets thrown off the surface by an event. Burst-only — nothing here emits on a timer. Droplets die as soon as they fall back to the surface.

presets.$about: Event types. Every key here becomes a preset name usable as water.emit(name, position) — adding one is a config edit, not a code change. Each preset inherits ripples.defaults and overrides what it needs.

impact.$about: Something fell into the water. Tight, bright, three quick rings plus a few droplets.

emergence.$about: Something rose through the surface. Starts wide, keeps expanding well after the object is clear of the water. Pass { scale: 0.6 } for a subtle surfacing or { scale: 1.4 } for a dramatic one.

ambient.$about: Background disturbance. Deliberately faint and low priority, so it is the first thing recycled when the pool fills — it must never cost a splash the player is watching.
